summary: Four churches (OLHC with its chapel, Queen of Martyrs, Resurrection, St. Josaphat). Weekend and daily Masses, Confession times and Monday Adoration agree across the bulletins read and the parish website; first-Saturday Mass, first-Tuesday Adoration, Thanksgiving, and the Dec 7-8 holy-day Masses are dated or monthly. The OLHC 4:00 PM Saturday Mass ends Jan 1, 2027 and is still included. Open: weekend chapel adoration hours, and a website-only St. Josaphat Saturday Confession.
